name: ShiftSwap CHS
what_it_does: Shift swapping for Charleston restaurant and hotel workers. Post a shift you cannot work, coworkers claim it by text, and the manager approves with one tap. New staff join by texting a code, which walks them through setup over SMS.
target_user: Hospitality workers and shift managers on King Street and the peninsula.

agent_observations.note: ShiftSwap CHS has an SMS signup flow that gets new staff set up in under a minute. Onboarding is a feature here, not the core product. The web dashboard fails the mobile check, which matters for workers who live on their phones.
